title: Geometric stalks of etale sum extension
statement:
Let $u:U\to X$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], let $A$ be a commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of modules over the constant ring $A_U$ on the small etale site of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $u_!F$ be the sheafified direct-sum presheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. For every geometric point $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], there is a natural $A$-linear isomorphism
$$
(u_!F)_{\bar x}\xrightarrow{\sim}\bigoplus_{\bar z:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U,\ u\bar z=\bar x}F_{\bar z}.
$$
Stalks are geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Under this isomorphism the germ represented by a section $s\in F(V\xrightarrow{a}U)$ in the summand indexed by $a$ of the presheaf on a pointed etale neighbourhood $(V,\bar v)$ of $\bar x$ is sent to the germ of $s$ in the summand indexed by $a\bar v$.

proof.text: For a presheaf F on U_et, let P be its left Kan extension along the opposite of the localization functor b : U_et -> X_et, and let B be the direct sum of the fibres of F over the lifts z of x. At W in U_et and v : x -> b(W), send a section to its germ at v.left followed by the inclusion of the summand z = v composed with the structure map of W. A refinement over U leaves z unchanged, and the stalk colimit relation identifies the restricted section with the original germ. Therefore the assignment gives a natural transformation from F to b.op composed with the skyscraper presheaf at x with value B.

source.place: Tag 0710, lemma-stalk-j-shriek, assignment of (V,y,phi,s) to x=u(phi)(y)

proof.text: Apply the universal property of the left Kan extension to this natural transformation, and then the stalk-skyscraper hom equivalence. This constructs a linear map e from the fibre of P at x to B, with the asserted formula on every section germ. The same two universal properties prove that linear maps out of the fibre of P are equal if they agree on all section germs arising from F(W) for W in U_et and v : x -> b(W). This is the hom_ext helper, using Mathlib Functor.hom_ext_of_isLeftKanExtension and Point.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv.

source.place: Tag 0710, lemma-stalk-j-shriek, first colimit and canonical map to the regrouped direct sum

proof.text: For each lift z and pointed U-neighbourhood (W,w) of z, forget its map to U to get the pointed X-neighbourhood (b(W),w). Send F(W) through the Kan-extension unit to P(b(W)) and then to its fibre at x. Naturality of the unit and the stalk colimit relation show compatibility with refinements. The fibre colimit universal property gives a linear map i_z from F_z, and the direct-sum universal property combines these into i : B -> P_x.

source.place: Tag 0710, lemma-stalk-j-shriek, inverse to the final regrouping of colimits

proof.text: On the germ of a section in a fixed F_z, the composite i_z followed by e is precisely the inclusion into the z summand. Stalk extensionality and direct-sum extensionality give i followed by e equal to the identity of B. Conversely, on each generator F(W) -> P_x indexed by v, e followed by i returns the same germ using the same W and v. The section-germ hom_ext statement from step 2 gives e followed by i equal to the identity of P_x. Thus e and i form a linear isomorphism. For a presheaf morphism alpha, its fibre maps commute with summand inclusion by DirectSum.lmap_lof and with germs by Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality. Naturality of the Kan-extension unit, followed by the same section-germ extensionality, proves naturality of e.

source.place: Tag 0710, lemma-stalk-j-shriek, final two displayed equalities and their inverse generator maps

proof.text: Specialize F to a sheaf. Mathlib Point.presheafToSheafCompSheafFiberIso, equivalently the IsIso instance for the fibre of toSheafify, identifies P_x with the fibre of its sheafification, which is u_!F. Compose its inverse with e. Naturality of toSheafify and of e proves naturality of this sheaf isomorphism. Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality identifies the germ of a sheafified Kan-unit section with the image under the sheafification fibre map of its presheaf germ; cancelling the sheafification isomorphism gives exactly the displayed section formula.
